{{Quote|Since the Battle of Endor, there has been much historic sightseeing and souvenir hunting on Endor, since the remains of the second Death Star and a multitude of crashed Imperial and Alliance warships lie decaying in the vast forests.|[[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]], in the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]''|<ref name="Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide" />}}
The '''Death Star ruins''' were formed from the remains of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]<ref name="Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide" /> when the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] was destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Dating" /> which filled the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor's]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] with thousands of [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of debris, ranging from pebble-sized bits to 100-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] sections of [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Endor and the Moddell Sector">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> Though the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] deployed shields and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to deflect falling debris away from their [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] on the Endor,<ref name="Inside the Worlds of the Star Wars Trilogy">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> a few chunks were still able to fall to the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] surface. However, Endor was spared any [[Endor disaster|significant environmental damage]]<ref name="Endor and the Moddell Sector" /> and the second Death Star's remains were left to decay in the moon's vast [[Forest/Legends|forests]], attracting historic sightseers and souvenir hunters by [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide" />

The agony of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] aboard the second Death Star manifested itself as an [[Vergence/Legends|angry clot]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy staining the fabric of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When in proximity to the battle station's wreckage, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] travelers were known to have suffered blackouts and even internal [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] when exposed to the noxious evil. Even those without sensitivity to the Force still experienced a vague tingling of dread.<ref name="Endor and the Moddell Sector" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Death Star ruins were originally created for the [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], a [[2001]] reference book written by [[Ben Burtt]] and illustrated by [[Sergio Aragonés]].<ref name="Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide" />
